d: Chakravati tuphan arnab ke asar se….uttar bharat se lekar madhy aur purvi bharat tak mausam ka mijaj puri tarah badal chuka hai… pichhle do dinon se ho rahi lagatar barish ke bad aktubar ke mahine men thand ne pichhle 75 salon ke sabhi rikord tor die hain… logon ke man men sabse bara saval yahi hai ki kya aaj…yani 31 aktubar ko…bhi badal barsenge ya rahat milegi… aaie jante hain desh ke alag alag rajyon ka taja mausam hal…
